gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans: Bold and loud up top, with Revalia stretching its letters wide. Noto Sans takes over below with lowercase bodies that fill most of the line height, quietly doing the steady work Revalia would rather not.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Wide, loose, and full of swagger, Revalia leads with an open-bottomed g and letters spaced far apart. And Noto Sans Adlam follows in a plain sans, its c, s and z standing tall and full, so a long stretch of text feels clear and unhurried.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unjoin: Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined keeps generous space between its curve ends and stems, with barely any height gap between cases. But Revalia's tall band and relaxed stride give the heading all the personality, so the plain sans can simply stay out of the way.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-anatolian-hi: Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs reads modern and tidy, its terminals pointing outward and its x-height climbing near cap height. And Revalia, spread out in its relaxed stride above, gives the page a loud opening that the sans then settles under.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Expressive is the right word for Revalia, whose open-curved g and widely separated letters make a heading that wants attention. But Noto Sans Arabic does its best work below, with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height that keep the text clear.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-armenian: Revalia's wide-striding letters give it a relaxed swagger. Noto Sans Armenian is the counterweight, with tall, full c, s and z and inviting round letters that make the sans-serif text feel welcoming beside such a showy heading.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-avestan: Noto Sans Avestan is modern and clean. If Revalia were shrunk down, its wide-spaced display character would lose its punch, while this sans-serif, with its pronounced x-height and curve tips that never touch, would stay readable at nearly any size.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-balinese: Big, brash and relaxed, Revalia stretches out its tall band of letters. Noto Sans Balinese answers with a breathing space inside every curve and short ascenders, so the sans-serif text sits low and quiet under the heading's showiness.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bamum: Loud, loose and wide-spaced, Revalia opens its g and lets the letters roam. Noto Sans Bamum is the one to do the quiet work, with big open counters in every small letter and curved strokes that stop before turning inward.
gen-gf-revalia-gf-noto-sans-bassa-vah: Noto Sans Bassa Vah reads professional and compact, its big midsection swallowing most of the line height. Revalia stays the showman above it, with a relaxed stride and an open g, while the sans-serif gets on with the text.
